prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your pet companion is being created!", "While we prepare your pet, enjoy this preview of your desktop playground."]
1: ["Desktop Visibility Check", "Look at your desktop! Can you see your new pet floating or walking near your taskbar?", "Yes, I see my pet!"]
2: ["Pet Photo Setup Checklist", "Follow these steps to ensure your custom pet model renders accurately."]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion pet adoption is officially confirmed!", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
4: ["Generating Your Pet", "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
5: ["Use clear, well-lit photos showing your pet's full face and body for best rendering.", "Well-lit photo recommended"]
6: ["Creating Your Companion", "Please hold on while your pet is generated."]
7: ["Save Your Pet & Progress", "Sign in to keep your pet, items, and settings safe whenever you re-open the app."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!", "Meet your brand new desktop companion. Let's get started!"]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready to Play!", "Click launch to meet your new pet on your desktop screen right now.", "Launch Pet Now"]
